# MP RC-XD: T5 parity (2026-10-23)

Scope: the multiplayer RC-XD killstreak (`rcbomb_mp`, vehicle
`rc_car_medium_mp`) against Black Ops 1 / T5 multiplayer, measured on real T5
and on this server with the same scripted inputs.

References:

- T5 GSC: `D:\CoD\COD-GSC-Source\T5-STEAM-GSC\maps\mp\_rcbomb.gsc`,
  `gametypes\_weaponobjects.gsc` (RC watcher, `weaponObjectDamage`),
  `gametypes\_globallogic_vehicle.gsc`, `gametypes\_rank.gsc`,
  `clientscripts\mp\_rcbomb.csc`.
- T5 engine: `D:\CoD\OpenBLOPS\Game\Shared\vehicle\nitrous_vehicle_controller.cpp`
  (view-steered controls, auto handbrake, jump), `nitrous_vehicle.cpp`
  (reverse scale, boost).
- CoDOL: `bin/home/codol_rawfiles/maps/mp/killstreaks/_rcbomb*.gsc`,
  `src/online/vehicle/` (the sh1x RC physics: `vehicle_ground_runtime.cpp`,
  `vehicle_sh1x_policy.cpp`, `vehicle_pulse_world.inc`),
  `src/online/weapon/bolt_attachment.c` (radius-damage distance rule).

## Method

The capture script `tools/t5cap/zz_rccap.gsc` runs in real T5 MP (Plutonium
t5mp, windowed, LAN, as the mod `mods/rccap`, so it never loads into another
T5 session) and, regenerated by `tools/t5cap/mk_rc.py`, on a CoDOL probe
server (`maps/mp/killstreaks/_rcbomb_t5cap.gsc`, started from `_rcbomb::init`
only when `rccap_scn` is set). Both games run the same rides on mp_nuked (the
map is the same geometry in both: the start-point scan matched to a unit),
from the same spot (51,1069) facing yaw 285, and log the car every server
frame: origin, angles, engine speed (T5 `getspeed`, CoDOL `vehicle_getspeed`),
the countdown/timeout client flags, and every player damage callback.

Inputs: T5 drives with `cmdexec "+forward"/"+back"/"+vehicleboost"` on the
local client; CoDOL with a test client and `sh1x_rcTestThrottle` /
`sh1x_rcTestButtons`. Steering is the driver's view yaw in both (the RC-XD is
a view-steered vehicle: T5 cameraMode 2, C1 thirdPersonDriver), held by
`setPlayerAngles` every frame at the car's yaw plus a fixed offset.

`python tools/rccap_analyze.py <log>` prints the per-ride numbers below.
Logs: `obj/rccap/` (T5 `t5_*.txt`; CoDOL before `c_*_before.txt`, `c_b_*`;
after `c_f_*`).

```
# T5 (copy tools/t5cap/zz_rccap.gsc to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Plutonium\storage\t5\mods\rccap\scripts\mp\ for the run)
powershell -File tools\t5cap\t5runmp.ps1 -map mp_nuked -timeout 330 -extra "+set fs_game mods/rccap +set net_port 28970 +set g_gametype dm +set rccap_scn drive +set rccap_rides accel,brake,turn15,turn30,turn45,turnl,turnm30,boost +set rccap_px 51.1 +set rccap_py 1068.9 +set rccap_pz -63.7 +set rccap_yaw 285 +set rccap_file t5_drive.txt"
# CoDOL
powershell -File tools\probe.ps1 -Port 17761 -Name rc -Map mp_nuked -Gametype dm -Boot 10 -Tail 160 `
  -Extra "+set rccap_scn drive +set rccap_rides accel,brake,turn15,turn30,turn45,turnl,turnm30,boost +set rccap_px 51.1 +set rccap_py 1068.9 +set rccap_pz -63.7 +set rccap_yaw 285 +set rccap_file c_drive.txt"
# other scenarios: rccap_scn blast (+set rccap_bots 10), rides bump, hit, hit1, timeout, jump
```

## Results

Speeds in inches/second, from the engine's own vehicle speed. "Before" is the
deployed server (rawfiles bb5369c, server 1f50154f); "after" is this pass.

| Behaviour | T5 | CoDOL before | CoDOL after |
|---|---|---|---|
| Use to control (antenna, 0.9 s freeze) | 0.95 s | 0.95 s | 0.95 s |
| Owner's body during the ride | stays at the deploy spot, hittable | same | same |
| Timer: countdown flag / timeout flag / blast | +20.0 / +26.0 / +30.0 s | +20.0 / +26.0 / +30.0 s | same |
| Car removed after its blast | 1.0 s | 1.0 s | 1.0 s |
| Top speed, forward | 330-334 | 334-340 | 334-340 |
| Speed 0.2 / 0.3 / 0.5 s after full throttle | 114-126 / 206-216 / 334 | 190 / 280 / 333 | 191 / 280 / 333 |
| Coast from ~332: speed after 0.5 s; stop | 199-200; 1.0 s over 172-180 u | 317; still rolling after 3 s | 190; 1.0 s over 172 u |
| Brake (reverse held) from ~332 to rest | 0.80-0.85 s over 150-156 u | 0.55 s over 78 u | 0.85 s over 142 u |
| Reverse top speed | 166-182 | 346-348 | 172-178 |
| Camera 15 deg off: yaw in the first second; peak rate | 90 deg; 129-132 deg/s | 113 deg; 212 deg/s | 100 deg; 115 deg/s |
| Camera 30 deg off: steady speed, yaw rate, radius | 210, 228 deg/s, 53 u | 227, 224 deg/s, 58 u | 227, 218 deg/s, 60 u |
| Camera 45 deg off: first-second yaw, peak rate; steady | 205 deg, 287 deg/s; 130, 255 deg/s, 29 u | 203 deg, 260 deg/s; 221, 226 deg/s, 56 u | 244 deg, 277 deg/s; 143, 264 deg/s, 31 u |
| Camera 90 deg off (spin): speed, yaw rate, radius | 101, 473 deg/s, 12 u | 221, 224 deg/s, 56 u | 114, 450 deg/s, 15 u |
| Boost (jump key): 330 to ~660 | 0.45 s, top 668-671 (2.0x) | 0.35 s, top 669 | unchanged |
| Hop | none (gostand, ADS, vehiclemoveup, vehiclespecialability tried) | 31 u on ADS | none |
| Driving into a standing player at full speed | stops 18-20 u (origin to origin); player not moved, not hurt; no detonation | drives through him | stops 20-23 u; not moved, not hurt; no detonation |
| One hit from an enemy (1 or 20 damage) | destroyed, blast 0.05 s later, kill credit to the shooter | same | same |
| Blast damage at 52 / 80 / 105 / 126 / 141 / 153 / 179 u from a player's origin | 284 / 249 / 217 / 192 / 173 / 158 / 123 | 306 / 270 / 244 / 219 / 194 / 182 / 144 | 283 / 248 / 215 / 190 / 170 / 156 / 122 |
| Owner hit by his own blast at 72 u (FFA) | 258 | 285-290 | 258 |
| XP for destroying an enemy RC-XD | 50 (team) / 30 (FFA) x xpScale | none | 50 / 30 x xpScale |

T5's blast is exactly `350 - 325 * d / 256` of the distance from the blast
point (car origin + 10) to the target's origin. C1's G_RadiusDamage measures
to the edge of the target's box, which reached 22-30 damage further at every
range; the RC car's own blast now uses T5's rule (as the T5 bolt grenade
already did).

The tight circles pass where the owner stands; with player contacts the car
now hits his body there (as T5's does when its path crosses him), so the
final 45/90-degree rides move the owner 250 units aside once the ride starts
(`rccap_ownerstep 250`, `obj/rccap/c_t45b.txt`).

## Changes

Native (`src/online/vehicle`, needs the matching exe):

- `vehicle_ground_runtime.cpp`:
  - T5 auto handbrake for view steering (`NitrousVehicleController::UpdateVehicleInputs`):
    driving forward with the camera more than 30 degrees off the car's yaw,
    above 40 u/s, locks the braking axle unless the car already turns the
    other way. This is what spins the T5 car at large offsets.
  - reverse target speed and reverse motor force scaled by T5's reverse scale;
  - the ADS hop off unless `sh1x_rcJump 1`;
  - chassis contacts against standing players and actors (players' boxes,
    narrowed by `sh1x_rcPlayerInset`), so the car is stopped by a player as
    in T5 and the player is not pushed;
  - policy overrides for the steering limit, the speed-scaled steering, and
    (optional) the boost multipliers.
- `vehicle_ode.cpp/.h`, `vehicle_pulse_world.inc`: the obstacle
  list and the box-sample contacts (same solver rows as map contacts).
- `vehicle_sh1x_policy.cpp/.h`: the fitted values, all `sh1x_rc*`
  dvars read at each RC spawn:

  | dvar | was | now | fitted to |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `sh1x_rcCoastG` | 0.08 | 0.5 | coast stop 1.0 s / 172 u |
  | `sh1x_rcBrakeG` | 1.0 | 0.62 | brake 0.85 s / 150 u |
  | `sh1x_rcReverseScale` | (1) | 0.49 | reverse 176 u/s |
  | `sh1x_rcMaxSteer` | (asset 30) | 70 | 90-degree spin rate |
  | `sh1x_rcMinSteerScale` / `Speed` | (asset 1 / 0) | 0.55 at 330 u/s | 15-degree turn at speed |
  | `sh1x_rcAutoHandbrakeAngle` / `MinSpeed` | (none) | 30 / 40 | T5 hand_brake_apply_delta |
  | `sh1x_rcJump` | (on) | 0 | no hop in T5 |
  | `sh1x_rcPlayerCollision` / `sh1x_rcPlayerInset` | (none) | 1 / 7 | stop 18-20 u from a player |
  | `sh1x_rcBoostSpeed` / `sh1x_rcBoostAccel` | (asset) | -1 (asset 2x / 3x) | already T5's |

- `rc_lifecycle.cpp` + `src/online/weapon/bolt_attachment.c`:
  an RC car inflicting radius damage measures targets from their origins.

GSC (rawfiles):

- `maps/mp/killstreaks/_rcbomb.gsc`: T5 `rcbombdestroy` XP for the
  destroyer; starts the capture when `rccap_scn` is set.
- `maps/mp/killstreaks/_rcbomb_t5cap.gsc`: the CoDOL copy of the capture
  (generated; inert without `rccap_scn`).

Tools: `tools/t5cap/zz_rccap.gsc`, `tools/t5cap/mk_rc.py`,
`tools/t5cap/t5runmp.ps1`, `tools/rccap_analyze.py`.

## Not matched, or not measured

- Throttle response leads T5 by about one 50 ms frame (CoDOL 191 u/s at
  0.2 s, T5 114-126). The probe's throttle is a server dvar with no client
  command delay; T5's goes through the local client's usercmd. The slope is
  the same (900-1000 u/s2).
- T5 scales splash damage on a partly hidden target (a player at 164 u
  behind a corner took 95 in T5, 141 here). Not ported: it is an engine
  difference for every explosive.
- The T5 fade to black when the ride ends (`fadeToBlackForXSec` in
  `carDetonateWaiter`) stays off: the C1 client switches the view back
  itself (see the comment in `givePlayerControlOfRCBomb`).
- Per-viewer enemy model, tread FX, engine and surface sounds: unchanged; the
  C1 client was not attached, so camera, sounds and FX were not compared on
  screen.
- Car-to-car collisions (two RC-XDs are ODE bodies that already collide) and
  water were not measured; mp_nuked has no water.
- Scramblers, flash and concussion stuns: unchanged (T5's 5 s stun and
  600-unit jammer radius were already ported).
